title: db_oracle Module
content_markdown: This is a module which provides Oracle connectivity for OpenSIPS. It implements the DB API defined in OpenSIPS. If you want to use the nathelper module, or any other modules that calls the get_all_ucontacts API export from usrloc, then you need to set the _DORACLE_USRLOC_ define in the Makefile.defs file before compilation.

exported_parameters.name: timeout
exported_parameters.description: Timeout value for any operation with BD.
exported_parameters.notes: If value of timeout parameter set to 0, module use synchronous mode (without timeout).
